stories.title: Deeside hair technician Jackie Holland wins Unsung Hero award
stories.summary: Coleg Cambria is celebrating national recognition after staff and campuses were honoured at two of the hair and beauty industry’s leading awards programmes. stories.title: Senedd Member speaks of adoption after mother’s death in childhood trauma debate
stories.summary: A Senedd Member who lost her birth mother at just three weeks old has spoken about her childhood experiences during a debate on the lasting impact of adverse childhood experiences. stories.title: Countess of Chester stroke service wins national award
stories.summary: A stroke rehabilitation service used by patients treated at the Countess of Chester Hospital has won a national award in London.
